results.title: Black Friday streaming deals cut Apple TV to $6.99/mo, Paramount Plus to $2.99/mo
Construction Activity Still Above Pre-Pandemic Levels
results.description: Residential construction delivered a mixed report in October, with housing starts and completions rebounding while building permits suffered a sizable decline. The biggest concern was single-family permitting, which fell nearly 9% from September, suggesting a weaker pipeline for future construction. Privately owned housing starts increased 9.9% to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.309 million , putting them 2.8% above October 2025 levels. Single-family starts rose 4.0% to 864k , multi-family came in at 433k. Building permits moved in the opposite direction, falling 7.4% to an annual rate of 1.295 million . That was also 8.7% below year-ago levels. Single-family authorizations dropped 8.7% to 772k , while permits for buildings with five or more units came in at 475k. The divergence between starts and permits is worth watching. Builders began more projects in October, but the decline in authorizations points to less momentum in the pipeline, particularly for single-family construction. Completions also rebounded, increasing 6.5% to an annual rate of 1.272 million . However, that was still 10.4% below October 2025 levels. Single-family completions rose 6.3% to 900k , while multi-family completions came in at 362k.

results.title: Niagara to Toronto in 11 minutes: Aspen Air expands service at Niagara District Airport just weeks after launch
results.description: The company is now offering twice-a-day, five-days a week service between the Niagara-on-the-Lake airport and Billy Bishop Airport on Toronto Island.

results.title: Walmart raises its outlook for the year for the 3rd time after a solid quarter, fueled by e-commerce
results.description: NEW YORK — Walmart reported solid third-quarter sales gains as the retailer continues to attract a growing number of customers across the economic spectrum that are seeking to cut costs in the face of rising prices.
